package.name: autoware_perception_msgs
package.description:
Vendored SUBSET of Autoware's `autoware_perception_msgs`: only the object types this stack's detector and tracker exchange (DetectedObjects, TrackedObjects and their dependencies).
Why a local copy instead of the upstream repo: the full autoware_msgs stack is not installed on this Humble and pulling it in drags a large tree for eight .msg files. The package NAME and the message field layout are kept identical to upstream on purpose, so the type strings a subscriber sees (`autoware_perception_msgs/msg/DetectedObjects`) match real Autoware and the definitions can be swapped for the upstream package later without touching a line of node code.
TRANSCRIBED FROM UPSTREAM, NOT COPIED FROM A CHECKOUT (no Autoware source was available on this machine). Diff against github.com/autowarefoundation/autoware_msgs before trusting interop with external Autoware tooling: a reordered field is silently wire-incompatible.
